channel_description: I tell one tech story per video for a general audience that likes technology: AI, robotics, space, medicine and farming. It's usually a specific company, machine or person doing something that sounds like sci-fi. I open by pointing at the thing ('This factory...', 'This robot...') or with 'X just did Y', then explain how it actually works in plain words, with an everyday analogy and sizes people can picture, like football fields. I flag 'the crazy part' and 'the wildest part', and I talk over footage, so lines often refer to what's on screen. I'm excited and optimistic: when there's an obvious worry like privacy or safety I name it, then turn to the benefits. I close on the big takeaway and a prediction about the next few years, often with a follow line for more tech, AI and robotics stories. No lists, no how-to advice, nothing to sell.
